name: Willy

palette.provenance: Sampled from the original v0.1 hand-drawn kitten art (cat_kit/reference-willy-v01.png; the identical sprite ships in every version of the game): white coat (median RGB 255,255,255), ginger patches #E8AF54 (median RGB 232,175,84) laid out as a saddle along the spine sweeping into the tail, a cap on top of the head between the ears, a small chest/throat patch, and a white tail with ginger along its rear; dark eyes, small pink nose (#D98C7A). No tabby stripes. This palette overrides GTA stray_cat's solid orange below: that is a different cat.

source: Construction idiom: GTA Fredericton scripts/world/wildlife.gd: SPECIES[stray_cat] (line 33), HOSTILE[stray_cat] (line 79), _spawn_river_cat() (line 217), _build_mesh() quad branch (line 776). Colouring: Willy's own, sampled from the original v0.1 art (see palette.provenance).
